doc: Spec 17's own views (§1.3). S2 and S5 are the boxes of ref.boots_feet and ref.head_face, so they are aliases. S6 needs the LookDev scene and V7 the calibration probe, neither of which is built yet (scope note: LookDev and calibration come after the camera, lights, floor and grade).

presets.label: hero_full
presets.note: S1: framing, light directions, grading statistics; UI masked in comparisons (§2.6)

presets.label: floor_feet
presets.note: S2: contact cores, boot reflection smudges, the start of the physical key shadow

presets.label: bg_left
presets.note: S3: the background set is deferred (scope note); kept for when it is built

presets.label: bg_right
presets.note: S4: the background set is deferred (scope note); kept for when it is built

presets.label: face_light
presets.note: S5: patch dE, nose shadow toward his left, cool left cheek, black under-jaw

presets.label: lookdev_rig
presets.note: S6: neutrality of the look-dev light, ColorChecker dE, chrome-ball light map; needs the LookDev scene (lookdev.py, not written yet)

presets.label: probe
presets.note: grey and chrome balls of Cal.Probe at the chest (0, -400, 1300) mm, which projects to (836, 254); the box is provisional, spec 17 names the view but not its framing, and Cal.Probe is not built yet
